## Peak Python-heap memory (tracemalloc), median over trials

CUBRIDdb allocates rows and buffers in C (CCI); tracemalloc does not see that memory, so its numbers are a lower bound and not comparable to pycubrid's.

| Case | pycubrid-main | pycubrid-1.10.0 | cubriddb |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| executemany_100 | 41.5 KiB | 41.5 KiB | 1.1 KiB |
| executemany_1000 | 364.4 KiB | 364.4 KiB | 1.1 KiB |
| executemany_10000 | 3,709.0 KiB | 3,709.0 KiB | 1.1 KiB |
| fetchone_10000 | 130.4 KiB | 130.4 KiB | 1.6 KiB |
| fetchmany_10000 | 131.7 KiB | 131.7 KiB | 45.2 KiB |
| fetchall_10000 | 2,196.4 KiB | 2,196.4 KiB | 2,183.6 KiB |

Process peak RSS (ru_maxrss) at the end of each trial: pycubrid-main: 39.2-39.3 MiB; pycubrid-1.10.0: 39.1-39.4 MiB; cubriddb: 37.2-37.4 MiB
